verdict.line: You win if you force Fury-stacked all-ins before level 9; you lose if the game drags past 20 minutes and Gwen's passive stacking and Hallowed Mist disengages take over.

brief.thesis: Renekton has a real lane-advantage window: his Fury-empowered W (Ruthless Predator) stun chained into E (Slice and Dice) outclasses anything Gwen has before she hits meaningful ranks. But the 48.4% win rate over 831 games says that lane win doesn't convert — Hallowed Mist lets her reset every bad fight for free, and A Thousand Cuts plus her E attack-speed steroid let her out-sustain and out-trade him once items come online. This is a lane you must close out, not one you can coast through.

theirWindow.when: Her E attack-speed buff is active
theirWindow.what: Skip 'n Slash gives her bonus attack speed, range, and magic damage on-hit for several seconds, and every hit procs A Thousand Cuts true/magic damage that heals her. Don't trade autos through this window — back off and let the buff fall off before you re-engage.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Hallowed Mist) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without the mist to hide in she has no way to break your target lock. Dump Fury into an empowered W stun and commit the full E dash combo immediately, because she physically cannot wall you off.

powerCurve.note: Neither has Fury stacks or W rank 2
Empowered W stun all-ins open before her kit scales
R bonus health beats her early weak ult
Her E cooldown shrinks, she starts kiting
Passive stacking and attack speed scaling take over

start.why: 50.1% win rate over 798 games at 83.1% pick — the lane-win sustain and early trade damage are what let you cash in Fury-stun all-ins before level 6.

boots.why: 51.4% win rate over 543 games — Gwen is 100% magic damage, so the resist matters more here than Plated Steelcaps' physical shred.

core.why: Highest-winrate opener (59.4% over 69 games in this path) — the shield proc rewards landing your full W-E all-in combo.
Armor shred stacks with your empowered E armor reduction to keep deleting her through Hallowed Mist resets.
Completes the top-performing core path and gives the tenacity/health buffer you need once her E attack-speed window starts outpacing your burst.

situational.when: the game goes long and you need to out-heal her passive's sustained magic damage over extended trades
her magic burst from stacked Thousand Cuts procs starts threatening you in single engages

runes.keystoneWhy: Your win condition is winning extended all-ins, not poke — Conqueror's stacking adaptive force and takedown healing directly offsets the sustain she gets from A Thousand Cuts.

summoners.why: 90.5% pick rate at 49.1% win rate — Ignite seals your pre-6 Fury-stun all-ins before her passive heal can offset the damage, and Flash guarantees your stun-E combo lands or that you can escape if she pops Hallowed Mist mid-fight.

playing.title: Auto first, stun second
playing.detail: Build Fury with autos before committing — at over 50 Fury your W becomes a 3-hit, shield-destroying, 1.5s stun instead of a weak 0.75s poke.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown windows
playing.detail: Her Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s on cooldown — the moment she's used it, you have a free window to land your full combo with no disengage available to her.

playing.title: Don't trade into her E buff
playing.detail: If she's just cast Skip 'n Slash, her attack speed and on-hit magic damage are live and healing her through Thousand Cuts — disengage and wait it out.

playing.title: Use R to force fights pre-9
playing.detail: Her rank-1 Needlework is on a 120s cooldown and weak — pop Dominus for the bonus health and area damage to force a kill before her ult becomes a real threat.

playing.title: Respect the true damage snip
playing.detail: Her Q's center hit is true damage and procs her passive on every snip — don't facetank it stationary, sidestep or close the gap fast.

playing.title: Don't overstay past level 13
playing.detail: Her E cooldown drops to 11s and her passive stacking starts out-trading your burst — win the lane hard before then or you start losing extended fights.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the power-curve timing and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read, not measured stats.
